title: January Meeting Demonstration Artist – Betsy Payne Cook: Pastels
paragraphs: The Guild’s Saturday, January 18, General Meeting will feature Betsy Payne Cook who will demonstrate painting with pastels. Betsy’s pastel paintings have been selected for inclusion in numerous juried local and national exhibitions, where she has won many awards including Best of Show at the Pastel Painters Society of Cape Cod’s National Exhibition in 2013. Betsy is an art instructor and teaches both pastel and plein air classes and workshops.

Our business meeting will start at 1:30pm with artist demonstration at 2:00-3:45pm at the Harwich Community Center in the Multi-Purpose Room. bodyHtml:
Michael Rudden January 13, 2025

The Guild’s Saturday, January 18, General Meeting will feature Betsy Payne Cook  who will demonstrate painting with pastels. Betsy’s pastel paintings have been selected for inclusion in numerous juried local and national exhibitions, where she has won many awards including Best of Show at the Pastel Painters Society of Cape Cod’s National Exhibition in 2013.   Betsy is an art instructor and teaches both pastel and plein air classes and workshops.

Our business meeting will start at 1:30pm with artist demonstration at 2:00-3:45pm at the Harwich Community Center in the Multi-Purpose Room. The meeting and demonstration is free and open to the public.  You will be warmly welcomed by our supportive community whether you are fledging artist or accomplished painter.
